title: The Mission of the Church
sourceBasis: World English Bible — 66-book Old and New Testament Scripture text already installed in Iron Sharpener
definition: The mission of the church is to glorify God by proclaiming Christ, making disciples, worshiping faithfully, serving in love, and bearing witness to the kingdom of God in the world.
summary: The mission of the church is to glorify God by proclaiming Christ, making disciples, worshiping faithfully, serving in love, and bearing witness to the kingdom of God in the world.
christFocus: Jesus Christ sends His church as His witnesses. The church’s mission flows from His authority, His Gospel, His compassion, and His promise to be with His people.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
The church is not gathered only for itself. God’s people are called to proclaim His excellencies, make disciples, and bear witness to Christ among the nations and neighbors around them.

The mission of the church begins with the Gospel. The church is not merely sent to do good deeds in a general way, though love and mercy matter. It is sent to announce Christ crucified, risen, and Lord.

The mission also includes disciple-making. Jesus commanded His people to baptize and teach obedience to all He commanded. Evangelism and discipleship belong together.

The church carries out this mission by the power of the Holy Spirit, not by human strategy alone. Christ’s presence gives courage and endurance to His witnesses.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
A church can become inward-focused, distracted by survival, preferences, or conflict. This doctrine reminds believers that Christ sends His people outward with the Gospel.

It also keeps ministry from becoming activism without proclamation or proclamation without love. The church bears witness to Christ in word, conduct, mercy, holiness, and faithful endurance.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Ask how your life and church are participating in Christ’s mission. Pray for Gospel boldness, serve with love, disciple faithfully, and look for opportunities to bear witness to Jesus. Do not let comfort, fear, or distraction silence the message Christ entrusted to His people.
